Spinach-Balls.html: Recipe: Spinach Balls from the kitchen of: Ginny Reilly 2 packs frozen chopped spinach 2 cups Pepperidge Farm herbal stuffing (crumbs) 2 large onions (chopped) 1/2 cup parmasan cheese (grated) 6 eggs beaten 3/4 cup butter (softened) 1 tblsp garlic salt 1 tsp black pepper or less serves: approx 12 people Back of card1/2 tsp thyme Thaw spinach on paper towels for one hour. Mix all ingredients and form into balls. Bake at 350 for 20 mins. Can be stored in freezer in air tight plastic container. Remove from freezer one hour before baking.

Red-Beet-Eggs.html: Red Beet Eggs 1 can red beets 1/2 C sugar 1 cup vinegar 1 doz. eggs Back of cardHeat red beets & sugar with vinegar & salt until boiling. Add eggs in large jar or covered bowl. Refrigerate 2 days. * 3-4 whole cloves 1 small piece stick cinnamon can be added.

Cheese-Bread-Squares.html: Cheese Bread Squares 1/4 lb. margerine 1 jar Kraft's Old English cheese 1 loaf unsliced bread Cut bread into squares approx. 2" square ["1 1/2" written above in pencil]. Combine first 2 ingredients well and spread on all sides of the bread squares. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake in 350° oven 12 to 15 minutes.

Pumpkin-Bread.html: PUMPKIN BREAD Stir in a bowl (do not use mixer) 3 Cups sugar 4 eggs 1 Cup oil Add and stir: 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. nutmeg 2 tsp. baking soda Back of cardAdd: 2 Cups pumpkin 2/3 Cup water Add: 3-1/3 Cups flour 1 Cup nuts (optional) Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour (or until toothpick comes out clean. DON'T GREASE PAN.

Bran-Muffins-2.html: Bran Muffins Mix & let stand until cool 2 C boiling water 2 C Nabisco 100% Bran Then cream 1 heaping cup Crisco 3 C sugar 4 eggs 1 qt buttermilk 5 C flour Back of card5 tsp. baking soda 4 C Kellogg's 100% All Bran 2 tsp. salt Add all this to 1st cooled mixture. Spoon into muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 375-400° for 20 min. Store in covered container in refrigerator. Do not stir when using again. Stores for 6 weeks. (Can make 1/2 of recipe)

Bran-Muffins-1.html: BRAN MUFFINS (Helen Krieg) Mix and let stand until cool: 2 cups boiling water 2 cups Nabisco 100% Bran Then cream: 1 heaping cup crisco 3 cups sugar 4 eggs 1 quart buttermilk 5 cups flour 5 teaspoons baking soda 4 cups Kelloggs ["100%" crossed out] All Bran 2 teaspoons salt Add all this to first cooled mixture. Spoon Back of cardinto muffin tins, making each 2/3 full. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes. Store batter in covered container in refrigerator for as long as 6 weeks. DO NOT STIR when using again. If batter not used up by end of 6 weeks, simply bake up the rest and store the muffins in your freezer. (1/2 of receipe could be used for smaller supply)

Polynesian-Cake.html:
POLYNESIAN CAKE

2 cups sugar
2 cups flour
1 cup corn oil (or other kind)
3 eggs
2 teaspoons baking soda
2 teaspoons cinnamon
2 teaspoons vanilla
2 jars junior baby carrots
1 8 oz. can crushed pineapple (juice too)
1 8 oz. can coccanut

Mix all together in same bowl with wooden spoon.

Bake at 350 - 45 to 55 minutes in 9 x 13 pan

Ann Reuter

Sand-Tarts-2.html: Sand Tarts [bracketed:] cream together 2 cups granulated sugar 3/4 lb. butter 2 egg whites 1 tsp. vanilla [bracketed:] sift together & add to mixture 4 cups flour pinch of salt Add gradually until dough is very stiff. Form into several cylinder-shaped rolls & wrap in waxed paper & chill for a few hours or overnight. Slice very thin, add toppings & bake 350° - approx 10 min. Makes approx 10 dozen.

Rum-Cake-JaneEarly.html:
Rum Cake (Jane Earley)

1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts
1 - 18-1/2 oz pkg. yellow cake mix
1 - 3-3/4 oz pkg. jello instant vanilla pudding
4 eggs
1/2 cup cold water
1/2 cup wesson oil
1/2 cup Bacardi rum
Preheat oven to 325° - grease & flour 10" tube or 12" Bunt pan. Sprinkle nuts over bottom of pan. Mix all ingredients together. Pour batter over nuts. Bake 1 hr. Cool. Invert on serving plate. Prick top.
Drizzle & smooth glaze evenly over top & sides. Allow cake to absorb glaze. Repeat until glaze is used up.

Glaze
1/4 lb butter or margarine    1 cup sugar
1/4 cup water                 1/2 cup rum
Melt butter in sauce pan. Stir in water & sugar. Boil 5 mins. stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in rum.

Rocky-Mountain-Toffee-Wafers.html: Nabisco graham Rocky Mountain Toffee Wafers 1 stick butter 1 stick margarine 1/2 cup sugar [bracketed:] Bring to boil & boil for 3 minutes 1 lb graham [crackers, in pen] 2/3 cup nuts [in pen] put foil on cookie sheets arrange crackers and spread with syrup above sprinkle with nuts then Bake 350° for ["8 to" added in pen] 10 mins. watch closely until brown take off while warm

Golden-Honey-Fruit-Cake-1.html: GOLDEN HONEY FRUIT CAKE 3 oz. candied lemon peel 3 oz. candied orange peel 1/4 lb. candied cherries 1/4 lb. walnut meats 1/2 lb. pitted dates 1/2 lb. candied pineapple 1/4 lb. preserved citron 1/2 lb. seeded or seedless rasins [in pen:] 1/2 cup flour PREPARATION OF FRUIT: Cut fruit peels and citron in long thin strips; halve cherries and dates; cut nut meats in quarters; cut pineapple slices in eights. Dredge combined fruits in 1/2 cup flour. Back of cardBATTER 1 cup butter 1 tsp. baking powder 1 cup honey 1 tsp. allspice 5 eggs 1/2 tsp. ground cloves 1-1/2 cups sifted flour 1/4 cup orange juice or grape juice 1/2 tsp. salt Sift dry ingredients together. Cream butter. Add honey gradually, blending thoroughly. Add eggs, beating well. Add flour and orange juice alternately, beating after each addition. Fold in fruit mixture. Pour into pans which have been lined with waxed paper and greased. Bake in 250° oven 3 to 3-1/2 hrs. [In pencil:] 2 hrs & 45 min.

Soft-Sugar-Cookies-1.html: Soft Sugar Cookies - makes 5 doz. [bracketed:] cream together 2 cups gran sugar 1 cup butter - 1/2 lb. 3 eggs, beaten 3 tsp. vanilla add 1 cup sour cream mix well [bracketed:] Sift together & add to mixture 4 cups flour 1-1/2 tsp. baking soda 1-1/2 tsp. cream of tartar mix well. Drop large spoonfuls on cookie sheet - 12 to a sheet. Sprinkle with sugar, add raisin. Bake - 375° to 400° for 10-15 min. Do not grease pans.

Ice-Cream-Cake.html: Ice Cream Cake 1/2 gallon vanilla ice cream - soften ice cream in refrigerator - don't let it get runny. Sauce 4 squares semi-sweet choc 2/3 cup Pet milk 1 cup powdered sugar 2 Tbsps. butter [bracketed:] mix together, bring to boil, take off stove, cool. 1/2 pk Oreo cookies 1/3 cup melted butter [bracketed:] Crush cookies in plastic bag with rolling pin. Add butter. Spread evenly on bottom of ungreased oblong pan. Spread softened ice cream evenly over cookie mixture. Pour choc sauce over ice cream. Freeze.

Worlds-Easiest-Scratch-Cake.html:
World's Easiest Scratch Cake!

2 c. flour              2 tsp. baking soda
1-1/2 c. sugar          1 tsp. vanilla
2 eggs                  1/2 tsp. salt
1 c. chopped walnuts
1 (2 oz.) can crushed pineapple (and juice)

Dump all ingredients in a bowl; mix by hand until flour disappears. Pour into ungreased 9x13 pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes. Can be frozen. Store in refrigerator. Improves with age!
—from volunteer Bertha Adams

Frosted-Cashew-Clusters.html: Frosted Cashew Clusters 1 Cup Oleo 2 cups Brown Sugar, packed 2 Eggs 1 tsp Vanilla 4 Cups sifted flour 1-1/2 tsp Baking powder 1-1/2 tsp Baking soda 1 Cup Sour Cream 1/2 tsp salt 2-1/2 Cups Cashew Nuts (2 pkgs) Back of cardCream oleo, sugar, add egg & vanilla. Fold in sifted dry ingredients, alternately with sour cream. Fold in nuts. Drop on greased cookie sheet - Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Cool & frost. Makes 8 dozen. Icing 1 cup Butter (Browned) Remove from heat. Add 6 Tbs Canned milk, 1/2 tsp vanilla. Stir in 4 cups Powdered Sugar. Beat until creamy thin. Ice cookies.

Rum-Cake.html: RUM CAKE (Jane) 1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts 1 - 18-1/2 oz pkg yellow cake mix 1 - 3-3/4 oz pkg jello instant vanilla pudding 4 eggs 1/2 cup cold water 1/2 cup Wesson oil 1/2 cup Bacardi rum Pre-heat oven to 325° - grease and flour 10" tube or 12" Bundt pan. Sprinkle nuts over bottom of pan (I put about 1/2 in cake mix) - Mix all ingredients together - pour batter over nuts - Bake 1 hour - cool - invert on serving dish - prick top - drizzle and smooth (over) Back of cardglaze evenly over top & side - allow cake to absorb glaze - repeat until glaze is used up. Glaze - 1/4 lb butter (oleo) 1/4 cup water 1 cup sugar - 1/2 cup rum Melt butter in saucepan - stir in water and sugar - boil 5 minutes stirring constantly - remove from heat - stir in rum.

Cheerios-Nuggets.html: RECIPE FOR: Cheerios Nuggets 1 cup packed brown sugar 1/2 cup marg. or butter, softened 1/4 cup light corn syrup 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. baking soda 6 cups Cheerios cereal 1 cup salted peanuts 1 cup raisins Back of cardHeat oven to 250°. Grease 2 rect. pans 13 x 9 x 2" or 1 jellyroll pan. Heat brown sugar, marg., corn syrup, & salt in 2 qt. saucepan over med. heat, stirring constantly until bubbly around edges. Cook uncovered, stirring occas., 2 mins. longer. Remove from heat; stir in baking soda until foamy & light colored. Pour over cereal, peanuts, & raisins in greased 4 qt. bowl. Stir until mix is coated. Spread in pan. Bake 15 mins. Stir; let stand 10 mins. Loosen mixture with metal spatula. Let stand until firm, 30 mins. Break into bite-sized pieces.

To this mixture add the dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Add vanilla. Mix and roll thin. Cut into desired shapes and top with beaten egg, chopped nuts & cinnamon sugar. Bake at 350° about 12 minutes. Golden-Honey-Fruit-Cake-2.html: Golden Honey Fruit Cake 3 oz candied lemon peel 3 oz candied orange " 1/4 lb candied cherries 1/4 lb walnut meats 1/2 lb. pitted dates 1/2 lb candied pineapple 1/4 lb preserved citron 1/2 lb. seeded or seedless raisins (golden) 1/2 cup flour Cut dates & nuts in quarters Dredge fruits in 1/2 cup flour Back of cardBatter 1 cup butter 1 tsp baking powder 1 cup honey 1 tsp allspice 5 eggs 1/2 tsp ground cloves 1-1/2 cups sifted flour 1/4 cup orange juice or grape juice 1/2 tsp. salt Sift dry ingredients together. Cream butter. Add honey gradually, blending thoroughly, add eggs, beating well, add flour & juice alternately, beating after each addition. Fold in fruit mixture. Pour into pans which have been lined with waxed paper & greased. Bake in 250° oven 3 to 3-1/2 hrs.

Apple-Caramel-Cake.html:
Apple Caramel Cake

1 package caramel-flavor cake mix
1 package sugar free butterscotch instant pudding mix
3/4 cup egg substitute
3/4 cup applesauce
1/3 cup fat-free mayonnaise or salad dressing, such as Miracle Whip
2 Granny Smith apples
1 cup packed brown sugar
1/2 cup chopped nuts (optional)
Fat-free margarine spray (pump type)
1/3 cup water

Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly spray a 13x9" baking pan with vegetable oil cooking spray.
In a large mixing bowl combine the cake mix, pudding mix, egg substitute, applesauce, applesauce, mayonnaise, and 1/3 cup of water. Mix well
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish.
Peel and thinly slice the apples "up and down" to make half moons. Place on top of the batter, forming three lengthwise rows. Press the apple slices slightly down into the batter.
In a small bowl combine the brown sugar and nuts (if using). Mix and sprinkle over the apples. Spray the topping with margarine until it looks damp.
Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on a rack and serve from pan. Top with whip cream or light Cool Whip.

*** This entire cake contains only 8 grams of fat.

Pumpkin-Pie-Squares.html: PUMPKIN PIE SQUARES Step No. 1: 1 cup sifted flour 1/2 cup quick cooking rolled oats 1/2 cup brown sugar 1/2 cup butter or margerine Mix well until crumbly. Press into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan and bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes. Step No. 2: 1 lb. can pumpkin 3/4 cup sugar 13-1/2 oz. can evaporated milk 1/2 tsp. salt 2 eggs 1 tsp. cinnamon Back of card1/2 tsp. ground ginger 1/4 [typed 1/2, changed in pen] tsp. ground cloves Blend well and pour into crust and bake another 20 minutes Step No. 3: 1/2 cup chopped pecans 2 Tblsp butter or marg. 1/2 cup brown sugar Combine & sprinkle over filling and return to oven for an additional 15 or 20 minutes, or until pumpkin is set Cool, cut into 2" squares (Makes 2 doz), or whatever size desired. Decorate with a dab of coolwhip & a pecan half.

Chewy-Oatmeal-Cookies.html: [In pencil:] Chewy OATMEAL COOKIES (Nan Wiley's receipe) 1 cup brown sugar 1 teaspoon soda 1 cup white sugar 1 cup flour 1 cup shortening 1 cup raisins ) ground 2 eggs 1 cup dates ) together 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 cup chopped pecans 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 cup cocoanut 4 cups oatmeal Cream together both sugars and shortening. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Sift salt, soda and flour together. Add to creamed mixture. Then add oatmeal and ground fruits plus nuts and cocoanut. Mix well. Back of cardDrop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheets. Bake about 10 minutes at 325-350 degrees. The cookies fall some after leaving the oven.

Date-and-Nut-Bars.html:
DATE AND NUT BARS

1 cup sugar
1 Tblspn butter
2 eggs, beaten
1 Tblspn hot water
1 cup flour
1 tsp baking powder
2 cups dates, cut fine
3/4 cup English walnuts

Sift flour once and add baking powder and sift again. Cream butter and sugar, add beaten eggs, water and flour. Add dates and nuts. Bake on baking sheet at 350° until light brown.

Double batch fills regular baking sheet and takes 23 minutes cooking time in my oven
Cut into squares while still warm.

Angelfood-Supreme-Cake.html: ANGELFOOD SUPREME CAKE Bake a Duncan Hines angelfood cake in a tube pan. Cut it into 16 pieces. Line the bottom of an oblong pan with 8 pieces; spread 1/2 the filling on top; add the 8 remaining pieces of cake and then the remainder of the filling. FILLING Cream together 1/4 lb. butter. 1-1/2 cup sugar, 1 tsp. vanilla and 1/4 cup lemon juice Separate 5 eggs - Beat yolks, then fold into the creamed mix. Next beat the whites & fold into the mix. Lastly, whip 1/2 pint (over) Back of cardwhipping cream and fold into the mix. It is best to make this receipe the night before or at least early the morning of the day it is to be served.

Soft-Sugar-Cookies-2.html: SOFT SUGAR COOKIES Cream together 2 cups granulated sugar 1 cup butter (1/2 lb.) 3 eggs, beaten 3 tsp. vanilla Add 1 cup sour cream Mix well Sift together 4 cups flour & add to 1-1/2 tsp. baking soda mixture 1-1/2 tsp. cream of tartar Mix well. Drop large spoonfuls on cookie sheet - Back of card12 to a sheet. Sprinkle with sugar, add raisin Bake 375° to 400° for 10-15 min. Do not grease pans. Makes 5 dozen cookies (I bake at 375° about 10 minutes)

Lemon-Whippersnaps.html: LEMON WHIPPERSNAPS 1 PKG (19-1/4 oz.) Pillsbury Lemon Cake Mix 2 cups (4-1/2-oz. carton) Frozen Whipped Topping, Thawed 1 EGG 1/2 Cup Sifted powdered Sugar Grease cookie sheets. Combine cake mix Back of cardwhipped topping & eggs in large bowl. Stir until well mixed. Drop by tsp into powdered sugar; roll to coat. Place 1-1/2" apart on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 min until light golden brown. Remove from cookie sheet. Cool. Makes about 4 doz cookies

Soft-Sugar-Cookies-3.html:
SOFT SUGAR COOKIES

4 eggs

2 cups shortening (1/2 butter)
2 tsp. soda

2 cups buttermilk

Bake at 350° - 375° for 10 minutes.

Scotcheroos.html:
Here's what's cookin': Scotcheroos
Recipe from the kitchen of: J. Hobday

1 cp. sugar
1 cp. light corn syrup
1 cp. choc. bits (6 oz)
1 cp. butterscotch bits (6 oz)
1 cp. peanut butter
6 cp. rice krispies

Combine sugar & syrup. Cook over moderate heat, stir frequently until mix begins to bubble. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter. Mix well. Add rice krispies. Stir til well blended. Press in buttered 13 x 9 pan.
Melt chocolate & butterscotch together over very low heat, stir til blended. Remove from heat, spread over rice krispies. Cool til firm. Cut in bars.

Fudge.html: FUDGE 2 pkgs. chocolate pudding (3-3/4 oz. size) (regular pudding - do not use instant) 1/2 cup milk 1 - 1-lb. box 10-X sugar 1 tsp vanilla 1/2 cup or 1 quarter butter or margarine Melt margarine, add chocolate pudding and milk, bring to a boil. Boil for one minute. Add this mixture to 10-X sugar and mix well. Add vanilla & mix again. Pour into greased pan or pan lined with foil wrap. Chill until firm & then cut into squares. (If desired, add 2 tbl. marshmallow or 2 tbl. Back of cardpeanut butter or chopped nuts or cocoanut before putting into pan.)

Patty.html: PATTY 2 cups granulated sugar 3/4 cup Karo 2 T. vinegar Butter 1/2 cup water Mix all ingredients in saucepan and bring to rolling boil. Keep it boiling gently and after about 5 minutes, start testing. Test by dropping small amount from spoon into cup of cold water. If the patty crackles and starts to harden, it is ready to be poured into Back of cardbuttered muffin tins or paper baking cups. Makes about 14 patties. (nuts or cocoanut may be added if desired. Black walnuts are especially good.)

Tuna-Casserole.html:
TUNA CASSEROLE

1 can cream of mushroom soup
1/2 c. milk
2 c. (7 oz. each) tuna, drained and flaked
2 hard-cooked eggs, sliced
1 c. cooked peas
1/2 c. slightly-crumbled potato chips

In 1-quart casserole, blend soup and milk. Stir in tuna, eggs, and peas. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes; stir. Top with chips; bake 5 minutes more or until hot.

Favorite-Cheese-Casserole.html:
FAVORITE CHEESE CASSEROLE
Betty Crocker recipes

Arrange in greased baking dish: 6 slices bread
Cover with: 1/2 lb. sharp cheese (6 slices, 1/8-in. thick)
Top with: 6 more slices bread to make "sandwiches"
Pour over cheese and bread a mixture of: 4 egg yolks, beaten (or 2 whole eggs), 2-1/2 cups milk, 1 tsp. salt, 1/8 tsp. pepper, 1/4 tsp. dry mustard

Chill in refrigerator so milk mixture will soften bread. Bake about 1 hour in moderate oven (350°). Serves 6 to 8.

Dried-Beef-Casserole.html: Dried Beef Casserole 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1-1/2 cups milk 1 cup grated cheddar cheese 1 cup uncooked elbow macaroni 3 tbsps. finely chopped onion 1/4 lb. dried beef 2 hard boiled eggs, sliced Back of cardCut dried beef into bite size pieces. Stir soup to creamy consistency. Add rest of ingredients, except eggs. Fold in eggs. Turn into buttered casserole. Store covered in refrigerator at least 3 to 4 hours, or overnight. Bake 350° for 1 hr. uncovered. Serves 4 to 6.

Leslies-Chicken.html: CHICKEN RECEIPE (Leslie's Recipe) 5 chicken breasts, boned, skinned & split 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 pt. sour cream 1 - 4 oz pkg cream cheese 5 strips bacon 1 pkg Carl Buddig sliced beef (optional) Wash chicken, pat dry. Cut bacon strips in half - place strip on underside of chicken, folding edges onto top side Take whole package of beef and lay pieces flat in bottom of rectangular baking dish - place chicken on top. Take package of cream cheese, cut into 12 equal squares. Place 1 square on (over) Back of cardtop of each breast (you'll have 2 remaining squares. Combine cream of chicken soup and pint of sour cream. Pour over top. Set oven at 325° - place dish tightly covered with aluminum foil in oven and bake for 1 hr & 45 minutes, basting occasionally. Remove foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes.

Mushrooms-and-Shrimp-in-Casserole.html: MUSHROOMS AND SHRIMP IN CASSEROLE 1 can (2 ozs.) mushroom stems and pieces Milk 1/4 cup chopped onion 1 T. butter or margarine 1 can (10 ozs.) frozen condensed cream of shrimp soup, completely thawed 1 cup sliced cooked shrimp (about 1 lb. uncooked) 1/2 cup shredded sharp process cheese (2 ozs.) 1 T. chopped parsley Dash pepper 2 cups cooked elbow macaroni (about 4 ozs. or 1 cup uncooked)(I prefer a little less macaroni) 1 T. fine dry bread crumbs chopped parsley (over) Back of cardDrain mushrooms, saving liquid. Add milk to mushroom liquid to make 3/4 cup. In saucepan, cook onion and mushrooms in butter until onion is tender and mushrooms lightly browned. Add soup, liquid, shrimp, half the cheese, 1 tablespoon parsley, pepper, & cooked macaroni. Pour into 1-1/2 qt. casserole. Top with bread crumbs & remaining cheese. Bake in moderate oven (375 degrees F.) 30 minutes. Sprinkle with additional chopped parsley. Makes 4 servings.

Lez-s-Chicken-Casserole.html: Lez's Chicken Casserole 5 chicken breasts, boned, skinned & split 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 pint sour cream 1 - 4 oz. package cream cheese 5 strips bacon 1 pkg sliced pressed beef (optional) Wash chicken, pat dry. Cut bacon strips in half - place strips on underside of chicken bringing ends up over top side. If using the pressed beef, lay pieces flat in bottom of rectangular baking dish - place chicken on top. Cut cream cheese into 12 equal squares, use 10 of the squares, placing Back of cardone square on top of each breast. Combine cream of chicken soup and pint of sour cream. Pour over top. Place dish, tightly covered with aluminum foil, into 325° oven and bake for 1 hr. & 45 min., basting occasionally. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes.

Baked-Seafood-Salad.html: BAKED SEAFOOD SALAD 1 (10 or 12 oz.) package frozen peeled and deveined shrimp 1 (6-1/2 oz.) can crabmeat, flaked and picked over 1-1/2 cups finely chopped celery 1/2 cup finely chopped green pepper 1/4 cup finely chopped onion 1 cup mayonnaise 1 teaspoon Worchestershire sauce 1/2 teaspoon salt 1-1/2 cups crushed potato chips 1/2 teaspoon paprika 2 tablespoons butter or margarine Drop shrimp into boiling salted water and Back of cardcook until pink (about one minute after water returns to boil. If shrimps are large, cut into half-inch pieces. Combine with crab, celery, pepper and onion. Mix mayonnaise with Worchestershire sauce and salt and fold in. Spread in buttered two-quart baking dish or into 6 one-cup casseroles. Bake in 400 degree (hot) oven ten minutes. Blend potato chips with paprika and sprinkle over mixture. Dot with butter. Bake ten minutes more or until potato chips are browned. Makes six servings.

Crab-Meat-Casserole.html:
CRAB MEAT CASSEROLE

1 lb. fresh crab meat in buttered casserole
1/4 lb. butter - melted
1/2 lb. Velvetta cheese - melt into butter
1 tablespoon flour and fill cup with milk

Put flour and milk into cheese and butter - then pour over crab meat.

Lay strips of cheese and cracker crumbs on top.

Cook at 350 for at least 1 hr. Do not cover.

Chicken-Casserole-1.html: CHICKEN CASSEROLE 4 chicken breasts, halved 6 celery stalks 6 large carrots 3/4 lb. sm. white onions (about 12) 1/4 cup chopped parsley 2 - 10-1/2 oz. cans cream of mushroom soup Paprika Preheat oven to 350°. Cut celery & carrots into chunks. In covered saucepan over med. heat in 1 cup boiling salted water, cook celery, carrots and onions 15 minutes. Drain. Remove skin from chicken breasts. Place (over) Back of cardchicken in 13" x 9" baking dish - sprinkle with parsley; arrange vegetables around chicken. In small bowl stir undiluted soup until smooth, pour over chicken and vegetables. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake 1 hour or until chicken and vegetables are fork tender.

Salmon-Casserole.html:

Cook
1/4 cup (each) chopped onion & celery in 1 tbsp. of butter until tender.
Combine
One 7-3/4 oz. can salmon, boned & flaked (with liquid)
One 10-1/2 oz. can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1/2 cup shredded sharp American cheese
2 cups cooked rice.
Turn
into 1 quart casserole and sprinkle 1/2 cup buttered soft bread crumbs atop.

Bake - at 350° for 30 minutes

Salt & pepper

Place meat on top

Use beef or pork

Kirchner's letterhead.] IMPOSSIBLE FRENCH APPLE PIE 6 cups sliced apples 1-1/4 tsp. cinnamon 1/4 tsp. nutmeg 1 cup sugar 3/4 cup milk 1/2 cup Bisquick 2 eggs 2 tbsp. butter or margerine Grease 10-inch pie plate. TRIPLE MUSHROOM MEATLOAF 1 pound fresh mushrooms 1 pound ground beef 1/2 cup chopped onion 3/4 cup plain bread crumbs 1 can (8 oz.) tomato sauce 1 egg, lightly beaten 1/2 teaspoon salt Ground black pepper 2 tablespoons butter or margarine 2 cups cold beef broth 1/4 teaspoon browning sauce (optional) 1/4 cup flour 1 tablespoon sherry Preheat oven to 325F. [torn] mushrooms and pat dry. Res[erve] [torn] medium-sized whole mushrooms. Chop enough mushrooms to make 1 cup; slice remaining mushrooms (makes about 4 cups); set mushrooms aside. Meanwhile, in a medium skillet melt butter; add reserved sliced mushrooms and saute until tender, about 5 minutes; remove and set aside. In the same skillet combine beef broth, browning sauce and flour; cook and stir until thickened, about 2 minutes. Add sherry, pinch black pepper and reserved sliced mushrooms; simmer, covered, 1 minute. Remove meatloaf from oven and place on a serving platter; let stand for 5 minutes before slicing. Waldorf-Turkey-Salad.html:
WALDORF TURKEY SALAD

2 cups shredded light and dark turkey meat, about 1/2 inch by 2 inches
2 large celery ribs, cut in matchstick pieces, 1/4 inch by 1 inch
1 large Granny Smith or other tart apple, cut in 1/4-inch dice
1 cup large walnut pieces
1/2 cup golden raisins
1-1/2 cups nonfat plain yogurt
1 tablespoon finely grated orange zest
2 teaspoons dried tarragon
Salt and black pepper, to taste

1. In a large bowl, combine turkey, celery, apple, walnuts and raisins.
2. In a smaller bowl, combine yogurt, orange zest, tarragon, salt and pepper. Mix well and toss over turkey salad. Adjust seasonings to taste. Cover; refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.
NOTE: This salad is wonderful served with leftover cranberry sauce alongside and/or garnished with orange slices.

Cranberry-Apple-Salad.html:
CRANBERRY-APPLE SALAD
Blended together with creamy HELLMANN'S.

2 cans (1 lb each) whole berry cranberry sauce
2 cups boiling water
2 packages (3 oz each) strawberry-flavored gelatin
2 tablespoons lemon juice
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 cup HELLMANN'S Real Mayonnaise
2 cups diced apple
1/2 cup chopped walnuts

Melt cranberry sauce over medium heat. Drain, reserving liquid and berries. Mix together cranberry liquid, boiling water and gelatin; stir until gelatin is dissolved. Add lemon juice and salt. Chill until mixture mounds slightly on a spoon. Add Real Mayonnaise; beat until smooth. Fold in cranberries, apple and nuts. Pour into 2-quart mold. Chill overnight. Makes 10-12 servings.

Creamy-Potato-Soup.html: Creamy Potato Soup By Carol McGarvey, Ask the Cook [Recipe only; the column text is not transcribed.] CREAMY POTATO SOUP 4 slices bacon, cut up 3 medium potatoes, peeled and chopped (3 cups) 1 large onion, chopped (1 cup) 1 stalk celery chopped (1/2 cup) 1 medium carrot, chopped (1/2 cup) 4 cups milk 2 teaspoons salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper 1 cup dairy sour cream 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour 2 teaspoons paprika In large saucepan, cook bacon until crisp. Drain bacon, reserving 3 tablespoons of drippings in pan. Set bacon aside. Add chopped potatoes, celery, carrot and onion to drippings. Cover and cook over low heat about 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in milk, salt and pepper. Bring mixture to boiling. Stir together sour cream, flour and paprika; gradually stir about 1 cup of the hot mixture in saucepan. Cook and stir just until mixture bubbles. Top with bacon pieces. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

New-Years-Day-Bean-Soup.html:
NEW YEAR'S DAY BEAN SOUP

Wash beans and place in a large kettle. Cover with water 2" -- add 2 TB salt. Soak overnight. Drain in the morning. Add 2 quarts water and ham hocks or ham. Bring to a boil. Simmer slowly for 3 hours. Add 1 large chopped onion, one #2-1/2 can of tomatoes.

College-Inn-French-Onion-Soup.html:
College Inn
FRENCH ONION SOUP

3 medium onions, thinly sliced
1/4 cup butter (or margarine)
2 cans (13-3/4 oz.) College Inn Beef Broth
1/2 cup water
2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce
4 slices French bread, toasted and buttered
Parmesan cheese, grated
4 slices Swiss cheese

In saucepan, cook onions in butter until onions are tender. Add broth, water and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, covered, 25 minutes. Spoon into 4 oven-proof bowls. Place piece of French bread in each bowl. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Top with Swiss cheese. Broil until cheese melts. Serves 4.

Corn-Zuccini-Casserole.html:
CORN-ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE

1/4 cup onions, chopped
2 tblsp. butter
1 lb. zucchini, diced
2 cups corn, fresh or canned whole kernel
1 cup grated cheddar cheese
2 eggs, beaten
1/2 cup Ritz cracker crumbs

Saute onion in butter in a large pan. Steam zucchini for eight minutes. Combine all ingredients in the onion pan except crumbs and mix well. Pour into a greased 8x8-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with crumbs and bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves six to eight.

12 medium sweet potatoes, cooked, peeled, halved lengthwise
